executive_summary: Comprehensive overview of Introduction to Aksha
key_value_propositions: Aksha is an intelligent surveillance system designed for automated monitoring with minimal human intervention.
Utilizes advanced technologies such as Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, and Generative AI for real-time analysis.
Capabilities include object detection, anomaly identification, and actionable insights for enhanced security.
strategic_insights: Flexible deployment options: Aksha can operate on Edge, Cloud, or a hybrid of both, catering to diverse business needs.
Supports microservices architecture for improved scalability and fault tolerance.
Real-time data processing capabilities ensure timely insights and proactive responses.
actionable_recommendations: In collaboration with NDIL, Aksha has been customized for worker safety, enhancing operational efficiency.
Phased development approach: Continuous improvements through Gen AI integration and architectural optimizations.
Successful implementation on Raspberry Pi 4B, demonstrating versatility and cost-effectiveness.
